label: Op Ghazab Day 178 — Day 9,085; 49 Militants Killed in Nationwide IBOs Aug 21; Bannu Suicide Bomb Foiled Aug 19; Panjgur IBO Aug 20
source: ISPR / UNAMA / Dawn / Express Tribune / Pakistan Today / Aaj English TV — August 22, 2026
delta: Aug 18: security forces kill 9 militants in separate Ziarat/Harnai and Surab, Balochistan IBOs. Aug 19: a TTP (Majlis Askari Karwan) suicide bomber attempting to ram a security forces MRAP in Bannu's Jani Khel Mali Khel is killed before impact, 2 soldiers injured. Aug 20: security forces kill 5 Fitna al-Hindustan militants in a Killi Suran, Panjgur IBO. Aug 21: ISPR announces 49 militants killed in a wave of high-tempo IBOs — 12 Fitna al-Khawarij fighters across Bannu, North Waziristan, Orakzai and Khyber (KP), and 37 Fitna al-Hindustan militants in 10 operations across Mastung, Mach, Khuzdar and Panjgur (Balochistan); PM Shehbaz Sharif and President Zardari commend the operations. No formal ceasefire, no Urumqi Round 2 meeting confirmed; conflict remains in active low-intensity escalation.
